worldcombat.skill.roleplay.summary: Temporarily borrow a target’s Ability, or a non-Pokémon’s strongest attack, movement or defensive characteristic. The target may be a foe or a companion who demonstrates for you.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.use.0: Borrow the target's Ability for this stretch
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.use.1: Copy a strong Ability from a companion or foe onto yourself
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.use.2: Switch to a better Ability before the fight
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.description.0: Range %1$s blocks, preparation %2$s. Against a Pokémon, copy its current Ability.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.description.1: A copied Pokémon Ability lasts %1$s, then your own returns. Suppressed or uncopyable Abilities cannot be borrowed.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.dwell.0: Deep role: duration x1.7, cooldown +18 ticks, for using one good Ability across a stretch of the fight.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.dwell.1: Light role: duration x0.6, cooldown -10 ticks, for switching often to follow the opponent.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.timing: Range %1$s blocks, %2$s s wind-up, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 1 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 1.5 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.preference.dw: On = deep role: duration x1.7 and cooldown +18 ticks, for using one good Ability across a stretch. Off = light role: duration x0.6 and cooldown -10 ticks, for switching often. Duration trades against cast frequency.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.preference.ai: The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means tracing from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to trace the target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
worldcombat.skill.roleplay.world: Against non-Pokémon, borrow their strongest attack, movement or defensive characteristic for %1$s, using its value at casting. Expiry or cleansing restores your own properties; later equipment and effects still apply.
